bug_info.bug_desc: When CVA6Cfg.RVU is disabled, the general mstatus update logic does not force mstatus_d.mpp to Machine mode. A CSR write can therefore leave the unsupported User-mode encoding (0b00) in the WARL MPP field of a Machine-only configuration, causing a subsequent mstatus read to return an illegal value instead of the only supported value, Machine mode (0b11).
bug_info.fix_hint: When CVA6Cfg.RVU is disabled, unconditionally force mstatus_d.mpp to PRIV_LVL_M after the normal mstatus update logic so every CSR write path leaves the WARL field at its only legal value.

bug_info.bug_desc: During MRET execution, mstatus_d.mpp is unconditionally set to PRIV_LVL_U (User mode) without checking whether User mode is supported by CVA6Cfg.RVU. In a Machine-only configuration, MPP is a WARL field whose only legal value is Machine mode (0b11), so assigning User mode (0b00) leaves an illegal value that can be observed by a subsequent mstatus read.
bug_info.fix_hint: Conditionally set mstatus_d.mpp to PRIV_LVL_U only when CVA6Cfg.RVU is enabled; otherwise, set it to PRIV_LVL_M to ensure the WARL field always holds a legal value in Machine-mode-only configurations.
